10.objective: Dismantle the large cyan ring and H assembly with its mirrored colored rails and clamps.
10.keyChallenge: This board uses four oversized rings, eight supports, and seven clamps. The small colored latches must clear before the cyan frame can move.
10.previousLevelDifference: Level 10 replaces the nine-ring grid with an oversized cyan circle, an inner H, eight supports, and seven clamps. Small mirrored latch groups must be dismantled before either central frame moves.
10.quickAnswer: Work from the upper-right latch cluster to the lower-left cluster. Remove the purple latch, orange arm, and green frame on the upper-right. Repeat that sequence on the lower-left, then separate the outer cyan circle from the inner cyan H.
overallStrategy: Read the board from its exposed outside edge. Level 10 starts with 4 rings, 8 rigid supports, and 7 clamps.
A ring is ready only when its gap faces the active connection and the path beyond that connection is empty. Release each drag and confirm the piece has separated before rotating the next ring.

removalOrder.result: The lower-left orange arm leaves the active interlock.

removalOrder.action: Remove the last colored rail around the cyan frame.
removalOrder.result: The lower-left green frame leaves the active interlock.

removalOrder.result: The outer cyan circle leaves the active interlock.
